scope: Full-description provenance and media-duration checks across the complete pinned catalog. Delivery-focused descriptions reviewed individually; this does not claim every catalog entry was manually read or watched.
method: Actual installed footage duration; alpha-aware destination contact estimate with frame-reviewed Magic Missile arrival. Separate local impacts, overlapping total/per-target volleys, delayed outcomes, area line geometry and cosmetic token reactions. No game-state changes or copied external macro code.

reviewed.name: Admonishing Ray
reviewed.rationale: A focused energy ray ends in a restrained contact recoil; no persistent injury or condition is assumed.

reviewed.name: Animated Assault
reviewed.rationale: Objects hover and lash throughout the selected area; debris is an approximation for arbitrary scenery objects.

reviewed.name: Aqueous Blast
reviewed.rationale: Water gathers around the fist on casting. The later one-action blast is separate and should be configured as another recipe.

reviewed.name: Arctic Rift
reviewed.rationale: Ice cues appear along the selected rift. JB2A has no literal jagged air crack; freezing is outcome-dependent.

reviewed.name: Arrow Salvo
reviewed.rationale: Several complete arrow flights converge on the selected burst before dusty contacts. This illustrates a massive salvo; the literal giant bow and arrows scattered at every creature are not available in this base composition.

reviewed.name: Asterism
reviewed.rationale: One selected line previews one starlight link. Five connected lines and breaking links require separate native placements.

reviewed.name: Barbed Spear
reviewed.rationale: A spear flies from caster and lodges at contact; its condition and removal stay with PF2e.

reviewed.name: Beheading Buzz Saw
reviewed.rationale: A spinning disc travels along the selected line, not a fire breath. Shield/disc footage approximates the saw; no decapitation is shown before saves.

reviewed.name: Biting Words
reviewed.rationale: The voice sends a directed sonic wave before localized contact; later attacks are separate playbacks.

reviewed.name: Blazing Bolt
reviewed.rationale: One heat ray per chosen target, staggered by target rather than three rays at every creature.

reviewed.name: Blazing Fissure
reviewed.rationale: Eruptions appear along the selected ground line and fade. Native terrain and prone outcomes remain mechanical.

reviewed.name: Blinding Bottle
reviewed.rationale: A conjured bottle travels to the selected burst, then releases a sight-stealing toxin.

reviewed.name: Blinding Foam
reviewed.rationale: A caustic liquid spray travels and clings around the face before fumes linger.

reviewed.name: Blister Bomb
reviewed.rationale: A small enchanted container travels to the selected burst, then releases diseased fumes.

reviewed.name: Blood Chestnuts
reviewed.rationale: Crimson seeds fly and lodge. A tree is not shown immediately because growth is a later disease stage.

reviewed.name: Bone Spear
reviewed.rationale: A pale piercing projectile follows the selected line from the thrall's former space. Place that origin manually; the caster is not the origin.

stages.label: Bone spear from chosen thrall origin

reviewed.name: Boomerang Shot
reviewed.rationale: Curved wood flies toward the foe. It does not render a return that the spell never specifies.

reviewed.name: Brine Dragon Bile
reviewed.rationale: Caustic spit reaches the wounded target before acid residue appears.

reviewed.name: Calcium Rain
reviewed.rationale: A pale cloud releases falling fragments into the selected burst. Falling rocks approximate tiny bone shards; persistent bleeding is not shown as an automatic outcome.

reviewed.name: Call of the Grave
reviewed.rationale: One sickening energy ray reaches the target; this short visual does not apply sickened or slowed.

reviewed.name: Camel Spit
reviewed.rationale: The initial morph is followed by its immediate spit attack; later spit attacks require another playback.

reviewed.name: Charged Javelin
reviewed.rationale: An electrical javelin flies and leaves a charged field after contact; Free uses an arrow silhouette.

reviewed.name: Chilling Darkness
reviewed.rationale: A cold unholy beam of darkness connects caster to target; its light counteraction remains mechanical.

reviewed.name: Chromatic Ray
reviewed.rationale: One colored beam reaches the target. This editable base visual does not determine the rolled color or its mechanics.

reviewed.name: Chromatic Wall
reviewed.rationale: A light barrier follows the selected remote line. Purple is a symbolic default; customize to the rolled color.

reviewed.name: Comet Charge
reviewed.rationale: Caster artwork lunges into a melee contact and returns. The chosen element and actual 120-foot movement require PF2e/manual resolution.

reviewed.name: Crystallized Vapors
reviewed.rationale: An icy pellet flies on the initial cast; the surrounding difficult terrain is separate.

reviewed.name: Dead Weight
reviewed.rationale: The thrall must be chosen as animation source to show its jump. Initial cue remains local instead of inventing a caster missile.

reviewed.name: Deity's Strike
reviewed.rationale: A divine weapon manifests above foe and strikes locally. Its directional secondary shockwave needs separate placement.

reviewed.name: Disintegrating Puddle
reviewed.rationale: A growing acid glob flies, splashes and leaves a short puddle cue.

reviewed.name: Divine Lance
reviewed.rationale: A bright divine beam resolves into a radiant contact flare.

reviewed.name: Doom Mark
reviewed.rationale: A void dart strikes and leaves a dark mark. Sustained attacks are separate casts.

reviewed.name: Draw the Lightning
reviewed.rationale: Lightning descends through foe, then returns charge to caster with a weapon/body glow.

reviewed.name: Earth and Sky
reviewed.rationale: Wind gathers at caster, followed by a cosmetic upward lift and return. Nearby creatures are not lifted unconditionally; real altitude, falling damage and saves remain mechanical.

reviewed.name: Elemental Toss
reviewed.rationale: A chunk travels and strikes. Stone is a symbolic default; customize its element to the bloodline.

reviewed.name: Enervation
reviewed.rationale: A void beam extends from finger along the selected line.

reviewed.name: Establish Ward
reviewed.rationale: Natural features animate inside the selected ward; the initial attack is local to that area.

reviewed.name: Exploding Earth
reviewed.rationale: A hard-packed earth ball travels, then shatters at target instead of opening the ground before flight.

reviewed.name: Fire Ray
reviewed.rationale: A fiery ray arcs toward the target; a short flame contact cue suggests the burning space without creating hazardous terrain.

reviewed.name: Flurry of Claws
reviewed.rationale: Claws appear beside two foes and slash locally; no claw missile or caster lunge.

reviewed.name: For Love, For Lightning
reviewed.rationale: A planted weapon crackles before an arc strikes the selected foe; later Sustain arcs play separately.

reviewed.name: Force Barrage
reviewed.rationale: Three complete shard flights distributed through chosen targets in order, each with its own contact. Editable three-action illustration; adjust total shard count for action and heightened choices.

reviewed.name: Force Rain
reviewed.rationale: A purple cloud rains solidified fragments on the selected 5-foot square. Tinted falling fragments approximate magical shards; this base uses the one-action footprint. Customize area and homing cues for two or three actions.

reviewed.name: Friendfetch
reviewed.rationale: Telekinetic strands connect caster and willing targets; token artwork briefly leans inward and returns.

reviewed.name: Frigid Flurry
reviewed.rationale: A cold gust follows the line, with a brief caster shimmer. Jagged shards and actual travel to the endpoint require customization/PF2e movement.

reviewed.name: Glacial Causeway
reviewed.rationale: Ice cues appear beneath the selected path. They are a symbolic path, not damaging cold missiles or automatic terrain changes.

reviewed.name: Glacial Skewer
reviewed.rationale: A large ice spike flies and makes contact before a cosmetic push; actual forced movement remains manual.

reviewed.name: Glutton's Jaws
reviewed.rationale: A maw appears beneath foe and bites locally; no missile flies from caster.

reviewed.name: Grim Tendrils
reviewed.rationale: Dark energy strands extend along the line; they approximate the described tendrils. Bleed depends on saves.

reviewed.name: Gust of Wind
reviewed.rationale: Wind extends from the selected origin to the far end; only cosmetic caster recoil is used, because forced movement depends on saves.

reviewed.name: Holy Light
reviewed.rationale: A blazing holy beam connects caster to foe, then flares at contact; darkness counteraction remains mechanical.

reviewed.name: Home Among Mulberry Leaves
reviewed.rationale: A short fabric-Strike gesture is followed by a local burst of luminous threads at the foe. No ranged missile, automatic cocoon or save-dependent condition is assumed; thread artwork approximates qi fabric and needles.

reviewed.name: Hurtling Stone
reviewed.rationale: A conjured stone is hurled; contact includes restrained cosmetic recoil.

reviewed.name: Hydraulic Torrent
reviewed.rationale: Water-colored streaming footage follows the selected line. Free uses a blue energy stream where native water footage is unavailable.

reviewed.name: Inner Radiance Torrent
reviewed.rationale: Hands gather light before a directed torrent. Base preview uses the two-action 60-foot line; longer casting and shining state need customization.

stages.label: Hands gather energy then release a torrent

reviewed.name: Lashing Rope
reviewed.rationale: Rope surrounds caster and lashes locally; vine art is symbolic and its object choice stays manual.

reviewed.name: Life-Draining Roots
reviewed.rationale: Root-like strands reach along the line, then caster receives a vitality bloom. Temporary Hit Points remain PF2e-managed.

reviewed.name: Lightning Bolt
reviewed.rationale: Lightning flashes outward from hand along the selected line.

reviewed.name: Lightning Lasso
reviewed.rationale: Electrical strands connect caster to foe, then crackle briefly at contact. JB2A strands approximate the thrown lasso; immobilized, restrained and later Sustain damage depend on the save and are not assumed.

reviewed.name: Lightning Storm
reviewed.rationale: A storm cloud forms over the area and one bolt strikes its center as a sample; actual chosen bolt placement remains manual.

reviewed.name: Living Thunderbolt
reviewed.rationale: Body changes into lightning before gaining flight; later pass-through damage is separate.

reviewed.name: Magical Fetters
reviewed.rationale: Ghostly energy strands fly from hand and clasp at foe; no literal manacle art exists in JB2A.

reviewed.name: Magnetic Acceleration
reviewed.rationale: A nail-sized metal shot flies from caster; magnetic fields are casting accents.

reviewed.name: Malicious Shadow
reviewed.rationale: The target’s own shadow rises and strikes locally; it never flies from caster.

reviewed.name: Massacre
reviewed.rationale: Death energy flows outward. The reverse wave only happens if nobody is killed, so it is not played unconditionally.

reviewed.name: Moonbeam
reviewed.rationale: A silvery ray of moonlight reaches the target and glints at contact; it does not use a scorching orange ray despite its fire damage type.

reviewed.name: Moonlight Ray
reviewed.rationale: A freezing silver-blue moonlight beam connects caster to foe, leaving a brief frost flash.

reviewed.name: Murderous Vine
reviewed.rationale: A vine appears from an adjacent surface and constricts foe; it does not grow across the caster-to-target gap.

reviewed.name: Pave Ground
reviewed.rationale: Dust clears along the selected ground line; no explosion, attack or forced movement is invented. Terrain changes remain manual.

reviewed.name: Percussive Impact
reviewed.rationale: A compressed sphere of sound is lobbed before the impact shockwave.

reviewed.name: Phase Bolt
reviewed.rationale: A magical missile flickers in flight, then pierces at contact.

reviewed.name: Pierce the Sky
reviewed.rationale: One arrow-shaped thunderbolt per selected target; contact includes a sonic flash. Hazardous lines remain manual.

reviewed.name: Polar Ray
reviewed.rationale: A blue-white freezing beam reaches the target, followed by an icy contact burst; no drained condition is applied.

reviewed.name: Prismatic Wall
reviewed.rationale: Seven colored light strips approximate the layered wall; native wall placement, vertical extent and counteracting remain manual.

reviewed.name: Propelling Air Stream
reviewed.rationale: A directed air blast strikes foe and briefly lifts caster artwork, then restores its pose.

reviewed.name: Purifying Icicle
reviewed.rationale: A life-infused icicle flies and lodges before melting; no ray or caster aura substitutes for flight.

reviewed.name: Radiant Beam
reviewed.rationale: Blinding light extends along the selected line; saves and dazzled conditions remain with PF2e.

reviewed.name: Ravenous Darkness
reviewed.rationale: Darkness fills the selected burst and teeth bite inside it; attack metadata does not imply caster missiles.

reviewed.name: Ray of Corruption
reviewed.rationale: A toxic spore beam reaches the target, followed by foul vapour and short acid residue; no object or creature is destroyed.

reviewed.name: Ray of Frost
reviewed.rationale: A narrow icy ray connects caster to target; the impact leaves a frost scar.

reviewed.name: Reanimate Foe
reviewed.rationale: Reanimation energy resolves at the selected corpse; the launching thrall’s separate origin and actor creation need manual handling.

reviewed.name: Scatter Scree
reviewed.rationale: Rocks appear along the selected remote line, not from caster. Terrain persists mechanically; the visual preview is temporary.

stages.label: Rocks cascade along the remote area

reviewed.name: Scorching Blast
reviewed.rationale: Fire gathers around the fist on casting. The later one-action blast is separate and should be configured as another recipe.

reviewed.name: Shadow Projectile
reviewed.rationale: A translucent missile duplicate flies to the triggering target; exact original projectile requires customization.

reviewed.name: Shadow Strike
reviewed.rationale: A dark tendril connects caster and foe, then gives a restrained inward tug.

reviewed.name: Shock to the System
reviewed.rationale: A cloud surrounds target before a revitalizing lightning jolt and healing bloom.

reviewed.name: Shocking Grasp
reviewed.rationale: Crackling hands touch target with local electrical contact; there is no ranged bolt.

reviewed.name: Siege Weapon's Blessing
reviewed.rationale: A fortune rune settles on the siege weapon; no attacking weapon flourish or caster lunge.

reviewed.name: Slashing Gust
reviewed.rationale: Directed air ripples fly from caster and slice each chosen target.

reviewed.name: Snowball
reviewed.rationale: A dense snowball travels and bursts against its target.

reviewed.name: Sonata Span
reviewed.rationale: Musical notes sketch the selected path. JB2A provides no literal load-bearing bridge; elevation and bridge mechanics remain manual.

reviewed.name: Spectral Blade
reviewed.rationale: A spectral blade flies out, makes contact and returns to caster.

reviewed.name: Spiritual Torrent
reviewed.rationale: Spiritual energy follows the base two-action line. Customize vitality/void color to caster and use another recipe for the three-action cone.

reviewed.name: Splinter Volley
reviewed.rationale: A tightly grouped splinter volley flies to each chosen foe. Bleed remains outcome-dependent.

reviewed.name: Sticky Fire
reviewed.rationale: A viscous bubble travels, sparks into flame at contact and leaves embers.

reviewed.name: Stone Lance
reviewed.rationale: A jagged stone lance travels and lodges; a stone-colored missile stands in for the exact lance.

reviewed.name: Sudden Bolt
reviewed.rationale: One lightning bolt descends directly on target; it does not travel from caster.

reviewed.name: Sun Blade
reviewed.rationale: Heat ray; description cues: impact, ray.

reviewed.name: Telekinetic Bombardment
reviewed.rationale: A landscape fragment flies to the selected burst before crashing into rubble; the alternate remote line needs customization.

reviewed.name: Telekinetic Maneuver
reviewed.rationale: Invisible force grips target and gives a restrained cosmetic tug; selected maneuver resolves separately.

reviewed.name: Tempest Surge
reviewed.rationale: Wind, cloud and static swirl around target rather than showing a horizontal missile.

reviewed.name: The Queen's Rainbow
reviewed.rationale: Seven colored light strips approximate the transparent rainbow. No creature condition is applied visually before saves.

reviewed.name: Thunderstrike
reviewed.rationale: Lightning descends on the target, then a delayed sonic ring and token jolt sell the thunder.

reviewed.name: Timber
reviewed.rationale: Leaf cues mark the falling tree's line; JB2A lacks a literal dead-tree fall. No unrelated stone or fire missile is shown.

stages.label: Tree fall shown by scattered leaves

reviewed.name: Tornadic Gale
reviewed.rationale: Wind flows from caster along the line. Pull, push and prone depend on creature sizes and saves; token documents are unchanged.

reviewed.name: Updraft
reviewed.rationale: A ground whirlwind lifts the targeted creature and lets its artwork settle back. The cosmetic rise and fall does not move its document or assume prone on a successful save.

reviewed.name: Vanish Weapon
reviewed.rationale: A small local portal snags the triggering weapon; no projectile flies across the scene.

reviewed.name: Vector Screen
reviewed.rationale: A transparent energy barrier spans the selected remote line. It does not fire ammunition at creatures.

reviewed.name: Vindicator's Mark
reviewed.rationale: A magical dart travels before a brief nimbus cue. The mark is private in the rules; persistent visibility is not changed.

reviewed.name: Vital Seed
reviewed.rationale: A seed embeds, void energy radiates outward, then vitality returns. The healing amount stays with PF2e.

reviewed.name: Warshard Shot
reviewed.rationale: A scrap shard flies to foe, followed by piercing contact and a spirit echo.

reviewed.name: Winter Bolt
reviewed.rationale: A hollow icicle flies and lodges. Its explosion happens at the end of the target’s next turn and is not part of the initial cast.

reviewed.name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
reviewed.rationale: Force and electrical energy erupt around caster as a cosmetic emanation cue.
